title: Crunchyroll Launches Premium Membership Sale for Ani-May
content: Crunchyroll announced today that it will be offering a limited time discounted Premium membership offer for Ani-May. The company celebrates everything there is in the world of anime during May across streaming, gaming, retail, and real-world experiences.
author: Anime Corner

title: Devil May Cry Season 2 Reveals Animated MV for New Single by Papa Roach
content: Devil May Cry Season 2 revealed an animated music video featuring a new single “See U in Hell” by Papa Roach ft. Hanumankind. The sequel is set to release exclusively on Netflix on May 12, 2026. Papa Roach’s “Last Resort” was previously used in a trailer for Season 1.
author: Anime Corner

title: Jujutsu Kaisen is Now a Part of the Marvel Universe
content: Marvel and manga have crossed over quite a bit in recent years, with Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man meeting Ultraman, Deadpool teaming up with My Hero Academia’s All Might, and even the Avengers fighting against the monstrosities of Attack on Titan .
author: ComicBook

title: Blue Eye Samurai Reveals New Season 2 Preview With Story Details
content: Of the many original animated series that Netflix has created in its history, we’d be hard-pressed to think of one that hit the ground running like Blue Eye Samurai . While the series had little groundswell to start, the story of Mizu roared to life and found a passionate audience.
author: ComicBook

title: 7 K-Drama Masterpieces Every Anime Fan Should Watch
content: In the current era, where pop culture is at its peak, it thrives through various forms of entertainment, including movies, TV shows, web series, and many others. However, in the past few years, anime and K-Dramas have emerged as two of the most popular forms of entertainment.
author: ComicBook

title: Short-Form Live-Action Series Based on Painter of the Night BL Webtoon Set for May Release
content: Lezhin Entertainment's short-form live-action series platform Lezhin Snack will premiere the Painter of the Night series in May. The company confirmed on May 4 that the adaptation of the hit webtoon by Byeonduck is scheduled for release on May 28 exclusively on Lezhin Snack.

title: Martian Successor Nadesico, Bodacious Space Pirates Director Tatsuo Satō Dies
content: NAGOMI added that Satō had been undergoing medical treatment for some time before his death. His family held a private funeral, and NAGOMI plans to hold a memorial ceremony at a later date. Satō was born in Kanagawa prefecture on July 7, 1964.
author: ANN

title: 2026 Crayon Shin-chan Film Unveils 3 Guest Voice Actors
content: The official website for Eiga Crayon Shin-chan Kikikaikai! Ora no Yōkai Bake-shon ( Crayon Shin-chan The Movie Super Strange! My Yōkai Monster Vacation), the 33rd 2D anime film in the Crayon Shin-chan series, revealed the film's three guest voice actors on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: 'World Is Dancing' Unveils Additional Cast, Opening Theme, First Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kazuto Mihara 's World Is Dancing manga revealed additional cast, a key visual (pictured), the opening theme and first promotional video on Thursday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on July 2 at 10:00 p.m.
